title: Contrastive Siamese Representation Learning for Predictive Maintenance of Electrical Submersible Pumps
abstract: arXiv:2609.22360v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electrical submersible pumps (ESPs) are essential in offshore oil production, where unexpected failures can result in significant operational and financial losses. Accurate predictive maintenance for ESP systems remains challenging due to nonlinear operating conditions, class imbalance, and variability among pump units. To address these issues, this study presents a fault diagnosis framework that incorporates class imbalance awareness by employing Siamese contrastive representation learning and prior-corrected k-nearest neighbor (KNN) classification. The method first extracts discriminative features relevant to fault detection from vibration-domain indicators and engineered harmonic relationships. A Siamese neural network is trained with class-balanced contrastive pairs to construct an embedding space that clusters samples of the same fault type and separates different fault classes. translated_title: 用于电潜泵预测性维护的对比孪生网络表示学习
translated_abstract: 电潜泵（ESPs）在海上石油生产中至关重要，意外故障可能导致重大的运营和财务损失。由于非线性运行工况、类别不平衡以及泵单元之间的差异性，电潜泵系统的精确预测性维护仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这些问题，本研究提出了一种故障诊断框架，通过采用孪生对比表示学习和先验校正的k近邻（KNN）分类来融入类别不平衡感知。该方法首先从振动域指标和设计的谐波关系中提取与故障检测相关的判别特征。通过类别平衡的对比样本对训练孪生神经网络，构建一个嵌入空间，使相同故障类型的样本聚集在一起，并将不同故障类别相互分离。为了进一步缓解分类过程中的类别不平衡……
tldr: 该研究提出了一种融合孪生对比表示学习与先验校正KNN分类的电潜泵故障诊断框架，通过类别平衡的对比对构建判别性嵌入空间，有效应对类别不平衡、非线性工况和泵单元差异等挑战，实现电潜泵的精确预测性维护。
